response.description: Azure Load Testing capability in Azure App Testing is now generally available in Switzerland North. Customers can now use Azure Load Testing, a fully managed load-testing service to generate high scale load and run simulations, easily identify performance bottlenecks through a rich dashboard of client-side and server-side metrics, get AI powered actionable insights, and integrate load tests into their CI/CD workflows. Customers can get started without any knowledge of load-testing tools, or use their existing Apache JMeter or Locust scripts.Learn more:about Azure Load Testing.go to feedback forum.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Load Testing in Switzerland North
